annotations.target_phrase: the Flatline coaching Case, navigating the shifting polyhedra
annotations.annotation_text: The Dixie Flatline construct provides real-time tactical navigation, spotting weaknesses in the Tessier-Ashpool security architecture and advising Case on when to inject viral subroutines to avoid triggering lethal black ICE retaliation.
sources: Brians, Paul. Study Guide for William Gibson: Neuromancer (1984). WSU.

annotations.target_phrase: heat sinks screaming on the deck, smell of burning flux
annotations.annotation_text: The immense computational load of running the military icebreaker strains the Ono-Sendai hardware to its limits. The smell of scorched flux and overheating copper bridges the abstract software battle with physical machinery.
sources: Bukatman, Scott. Terminal Identity. Duke UP, 1993.
